provenance_notes.resnet50_metric_clarification: The ResNet-50 v2 metric 91.79% is VALIDATION ACCURACY from Epoch 19 of the 20-epoch BigEarthNet v2.0 training run. It is NOT mAP. The corresponding Validation Macro F1 is 70.38%. On the test set of 119,825 samples, Test Accuracy is 91.67% and Test Macro F1 is 65.15%.
provenance_notes.resnet18_clarification: ResNet-18 is actively used in this project as the Siamese dual-stream backbone of the BIT Change Detection Specialist (bit-change-detection), trained for 10 epochs on LEVIR-CD with 96.98% overall accuracy. There is no ResNet-18 checkpoint for LULC on disk; the production LULC classifier is ResNet-50.
provenance_notes.deterministic_calculation_note: DETERMINISTIC indicates that the numerical operation is deterministic given the supplied raster geometry, masks, and metadata. It does not by itself establish the accuracy of upstream model-derived masks or classifications.
